in_marathi.name: Balajee
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Strength
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balajee हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balajee is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Lord of Strength'. In Hindu mythology, Balajee is an epithet of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe. He is also known as 'Balarama', the elder brother of Lord Krishna, who embodies strength and courage.
